raw_read_scope: Motion observations for development participants only
persistent_definition: True Deep/REM with Light predicted by every included recipe
scope: Post-hoc development diagnostics; correlated recipes and reused participants

feature_definitions.heart_rate_delta_past: Current mean minus strictly previous eligible-epoch mean
feature_definitions.motion_vector_change_mean: Mean axis-vector change over admissible within-epoch pairs
feature_definitions.units: Heart rate in source BPM; motion changes in source acceleration units
feature_definitions.motion_grid_change_mean: Mean axis-vector change between supported neighboring fixed-grid points; source acceleration units, not jerk or a validated physiological measure
feature_definitions.motion_grid_point_fraction: Supported grid points divided by nominal grid points
feature_definitions.motion_grid_pair_fraction: Supported neighboring pairs divided by nominal grid pairs
feature_definitions.motion_grid_age_max_seconds: Maximum source age among supported grid points
feature_definitions.motion_grid_actual_lag_max_seconds: Maximum actual source lag in supported grid pairs
feature_definitions.motion_grid_definition: Interior ticks every 1 seconds; source age at most 0.2 seconds; 29 nominal points and 28 neighboring pairs per 30-second epoch
feature_definitions.motion_grid_policy: Within-epoch backward sample hold only; no future samples or cross-epoch pairs. Fixed nominal lag does not establish acquisition-cadence independence. Missing pair support remains missing rather than zero motion. Support cutoffs are label-free post-hoc descriptions, not training selection.
